about.text: A sharp, spicy variant of Appenzeller from eastern Switzerland and Vorarlberg, naturally ripened for four to five months. Traditionally it is made on farms in winter, when cows give less milk and eat hay, which intensifies the flavour.

sources.text: The variant, its ripening, fat and region, from the Räßkäse article; its quarter-fat status, from the Appenzeller article.
